description: Reads what WooCommerce on the connected site really offers: products with id, name, price and the store currency, either by a search word (name or SKU) or by product ids. It also answers whether a voucher code already exists in the shop. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it to NAME a product id before putting an offer into the room (that is wi_change_webinar_offer), instead of asking the host to look the number up in their shop. When WooCommerce does not run on the site the answer says so, and the host sells through a link instead. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

coupon_codes.description: Voucher codes to check: does each already exist in this shop?

limit.description: How many products to return for a search, 1-50. Default 10.

search.description: Search products by name or SKU.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_list_webinar_products
title: Read the products of the shop
